features.notes: Verifies E1–E7, 73 total keys, 43 white/30 black, and chromatic black-key placement.
Verifies six ordered normalized hardware sections and their measured fractions.
Verifies dense, section-specific control inventory and globally stable IDs.
Verifies pointer and keyboard press/release states on piano keys.
Verifies button state toggles its LED and updates the program display.
Verifies keyboard and pointer knob changes, clamping, and visual value reflection.
Verifies accessible names, semantic roles, focusability, and keyboard operation.
Verifies one continuous chassis and the absence of a marketing region above it.
Covers note-on/off, repeated-note replacement, all-notes-off, and immediate cleanup.
Covers held, sustained, released, pedal-up, UI pedal, and panic transitions.
Covers concurrent voices, oldest-voice stealing, release, and final cleanup.
Covers nonlinear MIDI velocity boundaries and pointer-depth velocity forwarding.
Covers mapped computer keys, repeat suppression, releases, blur cleanup, and rendered active state.
Covers note/velocity messages, note-on-zero, sustain CC64, disconnected inputs, routing, and denied permission.
Covers clamped master-volume and dry/wet reverb values reaching the injected audio graph.
Verifies sample preparation failure selects an offline fallback that still starts voices.
Retains every Stage 1 model, interaction, accessibility, and chassis regression test.
Covers six modeled families, drawbar bounds, percussion, rotary/drive routing, and independent two-layer note lifecycle.
Covers oscillator wave/shape/detune, filter, ADR envelope, LFO modulation, bounds, and three-layer-capable note lifecycle.
Covers seven layers, enable, focus, levels, engine reassignment, and effect-chain targeting.
Covers normalized split boundaries, four zones, membership, and note routing across boundaries.
Covers source/destination assignment, interpolation, clamping, replacement, clearing, and removal.
Covers all 17 required effect types, bypass, dry/wet mix, ordering, per-layer targets, and shared Organ routing.
Covers deep save/load restoration of layers, splits, engines, effects and morphs plus factory/user browsing.
Covers contextual page navigation, parameter drafts, confirm/cancel, close, and invoking-control focus return.
Retains every inherited Stage 1 visual/interaction test and all Stage 2 Piano, input, MIDI, fallback, routing, and regression tests.
